data.one_liner: Generate Flutter widget tests from Gherkin feature files
data.what_it_does: bdd_widget_test parses *.feature files written in Gherkin and uses build_runner to generate plain Dart widget tests. The generated tests import material_ui and can include golden steps, making test writing natural language driven.
use_when: Automated test generation from feature files
avoid_when: Writing complex widget logic that requires custom test code
Projects that prefer hand‑written testWidgets without generation
strengths: Easy to write tests in natural language
Integrates with build_runner for automatic code generation
Supports golden tests without extra packages
Provides an agent skill for step implementation
weaknesses: Only supports widget tests, not unit or integration tests
Relies on Gherkin syntax which may be unfamiliar to some developers
data.setup_notes: Add build_runner, bdd_widget_test, and material_ui to dev_dependencies. Run `dart run build_runner watch --delete-conflicting-outputs` to generate tests.
data.minimal_example:
```dart
// feature file
Feature: Counter
  Scenario: Initial counter value is 0
    Given the app is running
    Then I see {'0'} text
```
// run build_runner to generate corresponding test file
